shortDescription: RRB CEN 05/2026 Paramedical Categories short notice released. Tentative vacancies: 560 (previous recruitment: 434). Online application is tentatively scheduled from 15 September to 14 October 2026.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released the indicative short notice for CEN 05/2026 for recruitment to various Paramedical Categories.

Total Tentative Vacancies: 560 posts. The previous paramedical recruitment had 434 vacancies.

Important Dates

  • Short Notice Date: 12 September 2026
  • Online Application Begin: 15 September 2026 (Tentative)
  • Last Date to Apply Online: 14 October 2026, up to 11:59 PM (Tentative)
  • Age as on: 01 January 2027

Vacancy Details

There are 560 tentative vacancies for various paramedical posts across all RRBs. Post-wise vacancy, qualification, age limit, fee and selection details will be given in the detailed CEN 05/2026 notification.

How to Apply

Eligible candidates will be able to apply online through the official RRB application portal at rrbapply.gov.in once the application window opens. Read the detailed CEN carefully before submitting the form.

This is an indicative notice. The detailed CEN 05/2026 notification and any corrigendum will prevail.
